Command: Do Not Worship God in Pagan Ways
Summary: When God cuts off the nations before Israel, Israel must not inquire how those nations served their gods and then serve the LORD the same way — including the abominations those nations did, such as burning children. Worshipping the true God with pagan practices is itself forbidden.
Commandment: Do not learn the worship of the nations and then worship the LORD in that way.
Application: The moral/ceremonial/civil division is a traditional classification, not Scripture's own division; this law is traditionally classed as moral. The New Testament carries the same warning: God is not worshipped acceptably by methods borrowed from idolatry, however sincere (1 Corinthians 10:20-21; Colossians 2:23 warns against self-made religion). Sincerity does not sanctify a pagan practice.
Purpose: Scripture's stated reason: every abomination to the LORD, which he hateth, have they done unto their gods (Deuteronomy 12:31).
